lines.text: Wait! 60,000 Miles of Blood Pipes Hidden Inside 1 Kid!
Most kids guess totally wrong about blood vessels length inside human body!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
A child has roughly 60,000 miles of arteries, veins, and.
tiny capillaries carrying oxygen nonstop—long enough to wrap around Earth twice!.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind 60,000 Miles Inside!
